title: fix(scenarios): the seed owns a row only by a person the row names, and fills each persona record’s user
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X3qrKgMTXcji1SpNaYQq7KK)_

Fixes #30913

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@objectstack/scenarios/runner` gains two exports, `personaRecords` (the record binding) and `rowOwner` (the persona a seed row is owned by). `personaHandles` keeps its signature and is now the handle map only (a value from a direct scope rule on a declared user-handle field); it no longer holds row ids or option values from other scope rules. On the three control cards its answer is unchanged. `seedApp` sets `owner_id` by the ruled rule and fills each persona record's `user` field.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:场景跑测的种子行属主(`owner_id`)只由"这一行指向的那个人"决定:行本身就是某角色的 `record`、行上已声明的查找字段指向该 `record`,或用户句柄字段写着该角色的句柄;同一行指向多人时按 `run.personas` 顺序取第一个。每个角色的人员行会把该角色的用户 id 写进它的 `user` 字段。构建提示的"Row ownership"一节重写,加一行平台边界说明(开源版没有层级解析器)。
- 为什么改:原来任何直接范围值都会认领属主,`service_desk` 上 237 条公开评论全归门户客户(其中 197 条是别的客户的工单),按 `group` 把 78 张工单给了组长,权限题因此在给卡片没要求的归属打分。这是维护者 2026-11-07 13:34 对 #30913 的裁决 Q1=A′ / Q2=C 的跑测器那一半。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `@objectstack/scenarios`(QA 工具包)。三张对照卡(crm、invoice、project)种子属主前后完全相同;其余六张按新规则变化,前后对照见下表。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/prompts.ts`(`rowOwner`、`personaRecords`、`rowOwnership`)、`packages/qa/scenarios/src/runner/orchestrate.ts`(种子循环)、`packages/qa/scenarios/test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`(service_desk 钉子)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts -t service_desk`,预期 5 个用例全绿,其中"no public comment is the portal customer's"一条断言门户客户拥有 0 条评论。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**Owner rule (`rowOwner`, `src/runner/prompts.ts`).** A seed row is owned by a persona's user only when the row names that person:
- it IS the persona's `record` (`customer` `cus_03`);
- a declared direct lookup on it (`expect.lookups`, target = the record's object) holds the record's id (`ticket.assignee` = `a02`, `ticket_comment.author` = `a02`, `department.manager` = `e13`);
- a declared user-handle field on it holds the persona's handle (`account.owner` = `u_sam`, the control cards' route, kept).

The first persona in `run.personas` order the row names owns it. An option value (`ticket_comment.visibility` = `public`), a row id scope (`department.id` = `dep_sales`) and a lookup to a row no persona is (`ticket.group`, `employee.department`) name nobody, so those rows keep the inserter, the admin.

**Handle map and record binding.** `personaHandles` is now the handle map only, so `probeValues` and `unheldHandles` keep their meaning; `personaRecords` is the record binding (`object/id` → persona, first in order). `personLookups` and `rowOwnership` are module-private.

**Seed loop (`seedApp`, `src/runner/orchestrate.ts`).** Handle fields are rewritten exactly as before (`seed.rewritten`, `handlesAsAdmin` unchanged). Then each persona's record row gets that persona's user id in its `user` field (`PERSON_USER_FIELD`), and `owner_id` is set from `rowOwner`. With no persona accounts (the gallery's screenshot boot) no `user` and no record-bound owner is set.

**Build prompt (`rowOwnership`).** The Row ownership section now says: which seed rows are persons; that the runner loads each one's `user` field, so the build gives each person object an optional `user`-type field named `user`; which lookups name a person; the persona order for a row naming two; that every other row is the admin's; and one platform-boundary line (the open-source server has no hierarchy resolver: `plugin-sharing` registers none, so hierarchy read scopes fail closed to own, `sharing-plugin.ts` "Open edition: not registered → hierarchy scopes fail closed to own"), so a person who must see rows another person owns gets them through what the build models (a read policy, a parent-controlled child, a field naming them). The old line that listed `public` = `portal_customer` is gone.

**Docs.** `packages/qa/scenarios/README.md` (Persona contract) and `docs/qa/scenarios/README.md` (the `record` paragraph) describe the rule. One `patch` changeset.

### Seed owners before and after, all nine cards

Measured by replaying `seedApp` over each namespaced card with one account per persona (a fake app that keeps what it is sent), on base `7c523aa1` and on this head. Counts are rows per object per owning persona; rows with no `owner_id` are left out.

| Card | Before | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `asset_lifecycle` | department dept_manager 1; employee dept_manager 4; asset dept_manager 28, employee 4; checkout employee 7; repair_order employee 2; disposal_request employee 1 | department dept_manager 1; employee dept_manager 1, employee 1; asset dept_manager 4, employee 4; checkout dept_manager 5, employee 7; repair_order employee 2, dept_manager 1; disposal_request dept_manager 3, employee 1 |
| `crm_account_with_contacts` | account sdr 2, admin 1 | same |
| `invoice_with_line_items` | invoice sales_rep 2, admin 1 | same |
| `leave_balances` | employee dept_manager 4; leave_balance employee 2; leave_request employee 10 | department dept_manager 1; employee dept_manager 1, employee 1; leave_balance dept_manager 2, employee 2; leave_request dept_manager 10, employee 10; approval_step dept_manager 28 |
| `order_to_cash` | account sales_rep 2; sales_order sales_rep 20 | employee sales_manager 3, sales_rep 1; account sales_rep 2; sales_order sales_rep 20; activity sales_rep 8 |
| `project_with_tasks` | task contractor 3, admin 3 | same |
| `requisition_to_receipt` | department dept_manager 1; purchase_requisition requester 10 | department dept_manager 1; employee requester 1, dept_manager 1; purchase_requisition requester 10; approval_step dept_manager 36; goods_receipt requester 10 |
| `service_desk` | customer portal_customer 1; agent team_lead 4; ticket support_agent 15, team_lead 78, portal_customer 5; ticket_comment portal_customer 237 | customer portal_customer 1; agent_group team_lead 1; agent support_agent 1, team_lead 1; ticket support_agent 15, portal_customer 15; ticket_comment support_agent 15 |
| `travel_expense` | department dept_manager 1; trip_request employee 12; expense_claim employee 10 | department dept_manager 1; employee dept_manager 1, employee 1; trip_request dept_manager 10, employee 12; expense_claim dept_manager 10, employee 10; approval_step dept_manager 27 |

The new owners all come from a lookup to a person row (`approval_step.approver`, `checkout.employee`, `employee.manager`, `goods_receipt.received_by`, `activity.owner`), the person rows themselves, or a manager's own requests (`leave_request.employee` = `e05`).

## Tests

- `test/runner/orchestrate.test.ts`, new `seedApp — the service_desk seed owns a row only by a person it names`: no public comment is the portal customer's (was 237), comments are owned only through `author` (15 to support_agent); t009 (assignee a02 + customer cus_03) goes to support_agent by persona order, t008 (group grp_tech + cus_03) to portal_customer; team_lead owns no ticket through `group` (was 78); `cus_03`, `a02`, `a04` carry owner and `user` = their persona's user, and no other row carries `user`; with no accounts nothing is owned; on `requisition_to_receipt`, `dep_sales` is the dept_manager's (through `manager` = e13) and only the two person rows among its employees are owned.
- `test/runner/units.test.ts`: `personaHandles` holds only `u_sam` on crm and nothing on service_desk; `personaRecords` on service_desk; `rowOwner` cases (record, lookup, two persons, option, group, handle, unheld handle); the Row ownership section on service_desk names the person rows, the `user` field, the person lookups, the order and the platform boundary, and no `public` or `grp_tech`; a card with no person bound has no section. One existing pin moved with the rewritten text (`u_sam` = `sdr` → `u_sam` → the `sdr` user).

**Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on committed HEAD `dba2b955`; the tests import `src/` directly, so no `dist/` leg). Each: mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed), suites red, restored to the HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty.

| Leg | Mutation | Red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | `rowOwner` takes any direct scope value again (the handle-field condition replaced by a marker) | 4 failed: the public-comment pin, the two-persona/group pin, the person-row pin, the `rowOwner` unit cases |
| A2 | the record's `user` field write deleted | 1 failed: the person-row pin |

## Acceptance notes

- **"The 15 tickets follow the persona order."** The ruling's item 4 says service_desk's 15 two-persona tickets go to support_agent. Its item 3 (a group is not a person) decides first: of those 15, 10 name team_lead only through `group` = `grp_tech` and portal_customer through `customer` = `cus_03`, so they name one person and go to portal_customer; the other 5 name support_agent (`assignee` = `a02`) and portal_customer, and go to support_agent by persona order. Item 3 is applied as written; the tests pin both halves (t008, t009).
- **Which lookups name a person.** A lookup declared in `expect.lookups` whose target is the object of some persona's `record`, the declared-never-inferred rule #30914 set for scope fields. An undeclared seed field holding a record id names nobody.
- **Global personas** carry no `record` on the nine cards, so they own nothing beyond the handle route; the rule reads a `record` on any persona if a card declares one.
- **No `user` without accounts.** The gallery's screenshot boot passes no persona accounts, so no `user` field is set; the prompt asks for the field as optional because every non-person row of that object carries none.
- **Clause-② reading.** The claim said `no` unless the diff adds an export; it adds `personaRecords` and `rowOwner` to `./runner` (it re-exports `prompts.ts`), so this PR declares `yes (widening)`. `personaHandles` returns a smaller map on six cards; that is a changed answer of an exported function, not a refused input or a compile break, so no `(narrowing)` arm is declared. The seat's contract review reads it.
- Grading is unchanged (Q2 = C): no scorer file moves.

## Verification

- Head `dba2b955`, base `7c523aa1`. `origin/main` has moved three commits since (`7fe019f4`, `007fdb1a`, `0f254f47`), none in `packages/qa/scenarios`.
- Dependency closure: `pnpm --filter "@objectstack/scenarios..." build` under the lock, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` under the lock: Test Files 30/30, Tests 599/599, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, its program includes `test/**`): exit 0.
- `node --stack-size=4000 node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js packages/qa/scenarios --no-inline-config` (the root `pnpm lint`, scoped; the package has no lint script): exit 0.
- **Not measured:** a live model run (paused by the maintainer) and a recorded-driver replay (no recording in this container); the seed is pinned through `seedApp` over the real `service_desk` and `requisition_to_receipt` cards with a fake app.
